ownerDirection: 把整套做好嗎？包括角色會擠在一起這件事情。
scope: Ordinary ground footpoint spacing in the existing Raising and Hunt update owners. This adaptation does not claim ROM shared physics.
stableOrder: Physical actor pool slot; fixed eight-direction slot-derived fallback at coincidence; no RNG or clock reads.

raising.owner: championshipStandaloneApp.advanceNativeRaising after the existing ordered actor updates, before home storage and presentation
raising.membership: Same native cage only; sleeping and other fixed ground actors remain obstacles without translation.
raising.follow: Mode2 uses the existing target Main cell width stop distance continuously and resumes when the peer moves away; existing mode timer and personality selection stay unchanged.
raising.food: Reserve the existing food.occupants station before approach; release on detach, carry, interruption, invalid target, eaten food, evolution and cage change. No second reservation authority. Legal same-side stations remain eight pixels apart.
raising.boundary: Existing X wrap, terrain and cageAt ownership; pure path checks including tile corners; unresolved crowding is permitted where no legal correction fits.

hunt.owner: nativeHuntFieldControls.step after stepNativeWildActor loop and before consumables.tick and rope reads
hunt.membership: Visible active ordinary roaming states1/2/3 at exact Z0 with positive HP.
hunt.boundary: Pure native terrain and field bounds only; trial positions never invoke side-effectful tool queryControllers.
hunt.projection: Write existing actor.positionQ12; display projects /2048, selection and rope read the same point.

battle.behavior: Existing XYZ distance <16 native pixels retreats each actor by half the deficit in XY. No new battle resolver or attack AABB changes.
battle.verification: Controlled 8-to16, exact16, skip, XYZ and coincident cases; one actual session tick invokes normal runtime once and memory footpoints match presentation.

acceptanceLimits: After collision correction, whole-AI trace identity is not claimed. Controlled tests and compiled normal browser entry evidence are separate from physical device acceptance.
